releases.title: Contract and Release Integrity
added: Exact dated monthly-profection chronology preserves civil-time policy, UTC and Julian boundaries, active-month ownership, and timezone provenance.
Aspect responses expose typed motion state, and small-body releases expose immutable manifests, checksums, notices, and loader receipts.
changed: The chronology-aware Hellenistic profile enforces stricter cross-component method, completeness, ordering, and provenance invariants.
Unified small-body resolution requires family qualification when asteroid and comet names collide, while dedicated family routes retain scoped aliases.
Optional-server enums use Moira's Python 3.10-compatible StrEnum boundary, and deprecated Decennial request selectors accept only omission or explicit null.
fixed: Longitude seam, relative stationary-state, duplicate pattern-edge, and complete Grand Sextile behavior are deterministic.
Generated publication consumes tracked Git sources, and catalog identity bytes remain stable across Windows and POSIX checkouts.
Metadata-only asteroid and comet manifests retained in the wheel now match the exact immutable release receipts without advertising absent shards as installed.
Malformed progression requests validate policy, datetime, body, and house-frame inputs before implicit kernel resolution.
validation: Hellenistic goldens and contract parity, aspect and pattern adversarial cases, small-body release and collision gates, Python 3.10 server smoke, and installed-artifact identity cover the release.

releases.title: Complete Asteroid Identity Catalog
added: A release-bound canonical asteroid identity artifact makes every body in external release 2026.07.27.1 addressable by its released name.
changed: The bundled canonical asteroid registry expands from 1,382 to 9,974 unique identities and corrects the former Asteroid20395 placeholder to Jacquet.
validation: Target, unified-ledger, shard, registry, reverse-lookup, REST search, and installed-wheel evidence agree on the exact release identity.

releases.title: Hellenistic Engine Completion
added: A score-free typed Hellenistic chart profile composes exact admitted planetary, aspect, lot, profection, Decennial L1/L2, and Zodiacal Releasing receipts.
Source-owned goldens and generated capability/API inventories make the Hellenistic contract drift-detectable.
changed: Hellenistic compatibility labels, booleans, and lists are projections of typed component truth rather than fabricated defaults.
Profection, Decennial, lot, solar-condition, besieging, Zodiacal Releasing, and whole-sign superiority semantics now preserve explicit policy and not-evaluable states.
fixed: Dorothean water triplicity, verified lot reversals, Halb/Hayz, solar boundaries, besieging completeness, and Zodiacal Releasing boundary behavior were corrected.
validation: Strict source-golden, contract-parity, unified-profile, OpenAPI, generated-inventory, Hermetic-containment, documentation, and release-identity gates cover the release.

releases.title: Installed Small-Body Manifest Readiness
fixed: Automatic discovery now distinguishes metadata-only wheel manifests from installed asteroid and comet ephemerides.
Explicitly configured and partially installed manifest sets remain fail-visible.
validation: Metadata-only, complete, partial, and explicit discovery modes were exercised through facade readiness, server startup, /ready behavior, and a wheel-shaped isolated install.

releases.title: Node Frames and Proper25 Families
added: Mean Node and Mean Lilith now expose an explicit mean-equinox versus true-equinox nutation policy.
The admitted asteroid-family catalog now contains 342 families, 200,726 unique numbered asteroids, and 221,095 many-to-many membership rows.
fixed: True lunar-node geometry is formed from the instantaneous osculating plane and transformed through the declared frame chain.
Family lookup and REST transport preserve nested and overlapping memberships while retaining one deterministic display-primary family.
validation: ERFA/IERS mean-node authority, true-node crossing invariants, named Swiss corroboration, catalog hashes/counts/overlaps, REST transport, and annotation refresh were exercised.

releases.title: Spatial House-Boundary Geometry
added: An opt-in immutable house-boundary vessel exposes admitted great-circle planes and Placidus semi-arc event curves with effective-system and availability truth.
validation: Plane-defined and Placidus boundaries, southern and high-latitude cases, sidereal labels, fallback, public exports, and REST serialization were exercised.

releases.title: Global Eclipse Circumstances and Cartography
added: First-class solar global circumstances include contacts, central-line limits, greatest eclipse, greatest duration, conjunctions, states, gamma, Besselian elements, and the WGS-84 footprint.
First-class lunar global circumstances expose mode-pure native and NASA-compatible astrometry, shadow geometry, magnitudes, contacts, durations, Delta T, and ephemeris identity.
Projection-independent adaptive spherical magnitude and obscuration cartography preserves convergence and antimeridian topology.
Typed REST endpoints expose solar global circumstances, solar cartography, and lunar global circumstances.
fixed: Near-singular hybrid horizon topology and polar/seam contour extraction were hardened without weakening component invariants.
validation: NASA/GSFC Besselian and hashed lunar-figure corpora provide the primary bounded evidence; named EclipseWise rows provide separate cross-model corroboration.

releases.title: Eclipse Geometry Hardening
added: A NumPy-free native solar-footprint substrate accelerates bounded candidate discovery while Python retains eclipse doctrine and topology.
A provenance-recorded NASA/GSFC corpus covers all 229 lunar eclipses from 1901 through 2000.
fixed: Solar footprint horizon-root discovery and exact sunrise/sunset junction assembly were repaired for affected 2027–2031 events.
Lunar greatest-eclipse geometry, classification, contacts, and candidate admission now share the declared physical event state.
validation: All 229 NASA events match the published type family, and forward, backward, and bulk searches recover the complete ordered sequence with greatest-eclipse TT residual below 55 seconds for that corpus.

releases.title: DE440 Historical Delta-T Repair
fixed: Historical, basis-sensitive DE440/LE440 charts now bind Delta T to the content-identified kernel's admitted tidal basis while unknown DE/LE identities continue to fail closed.
validation: Content-derived identity, historical clock conversion, unchanged modern direct-EOP behavior, and retained unknown-identity refusal were exercised.

releases.title: Source-Scoped Policy and Evidence
added: Dignity computation now exposes independent Halb and Oriental/Occidental inclusion policies across the engine and all six REST routes.
Bulk solar and lunar eclipse ranges use conservative native TT syzygy candidates while Python retains time policy, physical refinement, classification, and result assembly.
The admitted Pancha Pakshi surface is explicitly source-scoped, provenance-bearing, policy-explicit, and has no ambient universal default.

fixed: Missing meridian crossings inside a bounded search window are represented as absent events instead of invented results.
Nakshatra and Panchanga phase boundaries now share exact half-open ownership rules.
validation: Pancha source tests establish source fidelity and invariants rather than empirical efficacy; Gauquelin evidence is limited to its named corpus; snapshots remain regression evidence.
